hero.title: Redefining Efficiency,
hero.subtitle: The ultimate full-stack foundation built for extreme flexibility. Powered by an advanced MVC plugin-based architecture, flawlessly merging Go's raw performance with Vue 3's intuitive interaction.
hero.tagline: Empowering the next generation of full-stack enterprise applications.

footer.copyright: © 2024 F.st. Built with Passion for Developers.

features.title: Built for Complexity
features.subtitle: More than just a framework—we are your business acceleration engine. Every line of code is meticulously crafted for high concurrency and deep extensibility.
features.perfDesc: Powered by Go 1.24, achieving microsecond-level routing and massive concurrency through zero-copy and memory pool optimizations.
features.securityDesc: Built-in physical-level backend isolation combined with Geetest behavior awareness, creating an impregnable firewall for your assets.
features.pluginDesc: Pioneering a hot-pluggable module protocol. Dynamically extend routes, models, and business logic without restarting services.
features.mvcDesc: Following the path of pure code cleanliness. Strict separation of logic and view makes collaboration and maintenance elegant and simple.
features.configDesc: Environment-based scheduling supporting dynamic theme injection, intelligent i18n, and secure admin path stealth mechanisms.
features.deployDesc: Frontend statically compiled into a single binary via Embed. No external dependencies—perfect for cloud-native and private delivery.

landing.feature3Desc: Built-in data visualization components for multi-dimensional business analysis and data-driven decisions
landing.feature4Desc: Intuitive interface design with rich interactive experiences, reducing learning curve and improving efficiency
landing.feature5Desc: Modular architecture with theme customization support, flexible configuration to meet different business needs
landing.feature6Desc: Perfectly adapted for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices, manage your business anytime, anywhere
